summary: Discussion threads highlight major vendor model/security events (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google), operator pain with Claude, new harnesses and git-supply-chain risks. | Official-vendor updates: model releases (Anthropic, Mistral), platform integrations (Vercel, Supabase, Daytona), and infra/security primitives (Cloudflare, AWS, Modal, DeepSeek). No social/operator field reports in this shard. | GitHub OSS snapshot: strong activity in agent workspaces (dify, Sim, Openlit), vendor product changelogs (GitHub Copilot autofix/permissions), and multiple infra primitives (MCP, memory plugins, browser sandboxes). Many repo-only signals need corroboration or user reports. | Package-layer snapshot: new/updated MCP servers, agent-security and eval tooling, plus mainstream vendor agent packages (OpenAI, Amazon). No social/operator field reports in this shard; many items are single-package evidence and need corroboration.
